# The Rigid Boxes

> The Rigid Boxes provides custom rigid boxes and tailored packaging solutions for brands and businesses. The website covers packaging by industry, material, and style, along with custom manufacturing, printing, finishing, design support, and quotation services.

The company focuses on premium rigid packaging and custom product boxes for industries such as apparel, bakery, cosmetics, jewelry, food, gifts, electronics, healthcare, and other retail applications. Packaging can be customized according to product dimensions, box structure, material, artwork, inserts, and finishing requirements.

## Customization, Ordering, and Manufacturing

- **Custom manufacturing:** Services include structural design, prototype development, printing, die-cutting, lamination, foil stamping, embossing, debossing, folding, gluing, assembly, and shipping.
- **Minimum order quantity:** The company states that it has no minimum order quantity (MOQ). Single-piece samples, short production runs, and large-volume orders may be requested. Some materials, styles, printing methods, and finishes may require higher quantities; single-piece orders may have a higher unit cost.
- **Quotation requirements:** An accurate quote may require internal box dimensions (Length x Width x Depth), material, quantity, printing requirements, finishing options, box structure, assembly requirements, shipping destination, and preferred production timeline.
- **Artwork and design:** Customers may provide production-ready artwork or request design assistance. Artwork requirements can include high-resolution images, outlined or embedded fonts, CMYK or Pantone color information where applicable, safe margins, and bleed areas.
- **Proofs and samples:** Digital proofs, structural samples, and printed samples upon request are available for review. Production begins after approval of the final digital proof or physical sample.
- **Production estimates:** The terms page lists standard orders at 8-10 business days and rush orders at 4-6 business days, with additional charges for rush orders. Timelines may vary by order size, customization, and seasonal demand.
- **Branding and finishing:** Website information references foil stamping, embossing, debossing, protective laminations, coatings, magnetic closures, fitted inserts, and spot UV. Availability depends on the product and project requirements.

### Additional Board Material Page

### Luxury Rigid Boxes and Rigid Box Types

Luxury Rigid Boxes is listed under the website's Box by Material group. The following pages are rigid-box constructions or types, rather than general packaging styles.

- [Luxury Rigid Boxes](https://therigidboxes.com/luxury-rigid-boxes/): Premium rigid setup boxes for luxury products, gifts, retail, and presentation.
- [Two Piece Boxes](https://therigidboxes.com/two-piece-boxes/): Rigid boxes with a separate base and removable lid.
- [Magnetic Closure Rigid Boxes](https://therigidboxes.com/magnetic-closure-rigid-boxes/): Rigid packaging with a magnetic closure for a premium opening experience.
- [Collapsible Rigid Boxes](https://therigidboxes.com/collapsible-rigid-boxes/): Foldable rigid boxes designed to ship and store flat before assembly.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Use the linked product or policy page as the source for detailed specifications, current availability, compliance statements, pricing, and order conditions.
- Do not assume that every material, printing method, finish, or box structure is available for every product or order quantity.
- For pricing, production estimates, samples, artwork, and order-specific questions, refer to the Terms and Services page or direct customers to the Request a Quote page.
- The product groupings in this file are a navigation guide. Product pages remain the authoritative sources for each packaging product.
